_comment: Per-edit mutation engine config (spec: docs/design/per-edit-cloud-mutation-testing.md). Auto-loaded by bare `npx stryker run` — including inside the cloud mutation Worker's Sandbox, whose runner does `stryker run --mutate <file>`. ignorePatterns MUST exclude .interlinked/: Stryker sandboxes by copying the tree and crashes on the harness's Unix socket (found live 2026-07-02). The vitest configFile keeps the per-mutant suite scoped so runs stay in seconds.
_mutate_comment: Default target only. Every real run overrides it: the cloud runner does `stryker run --mutate <file>` for the edited file, and the detector-recall sweep (verification-density program Phase 3) points it at a detector. Left narrow so a bare `npx stryker run` is fast rather than a whole-repo job.
_mutator_comment: Operator coverage is DECLARED, not inherited. Stryker's defaults are a moving target across versions, and a silently-shrinking operator set weakens every mutation score in the repo without changing a single number in a baseline — exactly the drift the baseline-integrity gate exists to stop elsewhere. excludedMutations is empty on purpose: the full operator set is in force, and `stryker-mutators.test.ts` pins that.
